Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, eCommerce
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff’s E-commerce team builds an app-to-web product that drives mobile app users to purchase on Shopify web stores. We operate like a startup inside Liftoff. Requirements shift as we learn from live customers, and most problems arrive without an internal playbook. We built the product from the ground up and have already shipped major performance wins.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambiguous problems into sound designs and execution plans, then drive them to production. You’ll own architecture and technical decisions for core targeting and attribution systems, and help shape the team’s work through design and code review. When customer performance drops, you’ll trace the cause through our systems, determine whether it’s a bug or a market signal, and turn the finding into a design.

Responsibilities:

• Own epics end to end, including scoping, design, delivery, and production health.

• Help set the team’s technical direction and long-term roadmap.

• Build privacy-compliant data systems that expand reach while maintaining accuracy.

• Design attribution logic that captures more of the purchases we drive without overcounting.

• Lead customer performance deep dives and turn findings into experiments.

• Research new tools and approaches, and recommend solutions that balance short-term and long-term needs.

• Review design docs and PRs, and help set the team’s bar for reliability, scalability, observability, privacy, cost efficiency, and documentation.

• Partner with ML engineers to improve conversion models, including training data and conversion signal quality.

• Build and extend our Shopify app and web pixel.

• Mentor engineers and help hold the senior engineering bar in interviews.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.

• Experience leading the design and delivery of complex projects across multiple engineers.

• Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus fluent SQL (Trino, Spark, or equivalent).

• A track record of taking ambiguous problems from scoping to shipped outcome with minimal oversight.

• Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance or data discrepancies across a multi-stage pipeline, from raw signal to reported outcome.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and event-driven systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent).

• You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set.

• Experience with identity resolution, probabilistic matching, or device graphs is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience with web attribution or conversion tracking, such as pixels, server-side conversion APIs, or attribution platforms.

• Working knowledge of browser privacy constraints and data privacy regulations.

• Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join our team and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem. If this role sounds interesting to you, we would love to hear from you!

Location:
This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:
We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. The role

The Field CTO, Media & Entertainment AI Infrastructure is a senior engineering leader who will initially operate as an individual contributor at the intersection of deep AI infrastructure engineering and the business of media and entertainment, with a clear path to building and leading a team as the business scales.

You will work alongside CTOs and engineering leaders at studio groups, VFX houses, gaming studios, agency holding companies, and generative AI model companies. • The Physics to P&L Narrative: Fluently demonstrate to executive stakeholders how infrastructure decisions , data lake locality, storage tiering, inference optimization, directly impact their business model and operability.

• Lead the M&E Product Summit: Chair a quarterly summit with Core Engineering leadership, using field evidence to drive roadmap decisions and maintain vertical momentum.

We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Europe 3PL operations manager

Position Overview

The European 3PL Manager owns Nebius's network of external warehouses and the performance of the 3PL partners who run them. The role ensures that high-value data center hardware stored and handled by third parties is received, stored, picked and shipped to the same standard as in Nebius-operated sites.

The manager controls 3PL operations through SLAs, KPIs, audits and system data, coordinates daily flows between 3PLs and internal teams (Transport, Planning, Back Office, ITDC, Security), and drives cost, compliance and continuous improvement across all external locations.

Key Responsibilities

• 3PL Network & Partner Management

• Manage the portfolio of external warehouses and 3PL partners across EMEA/US/APAC.

• Own contracts, SLAs and rate cards together with Procurement and Legal; prepare renewals and renegotiations.

• Run monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with each 3PL; agree and track improvement plans.

• Act as the primary escalation point for 3PL partners and for internal teams on 3PL-related issues.

• Operations Control

• Set and enforce operating standards for 3PLs: receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and returns (RMA).

• Ensure 3PLs follow Nebius SOPs for handling heavy, fragile, high-value equipment (racks, GPU servers, HSM devices).

• Monitor daily operational performance through WMS data, reports and site visits; act on deviations.

• Lead root-cause analysis of incidents (damage, loss, mis-shipments, delays) and follow corrective and preventive actions to closure.

• Inventory Control & Audits

• Ensure inventory accuracy at external sites: cycle counts, annual stock takes and reconciliation with ERP/WMS.

• Organise periodic on-site audits and inspections of 3PL warehouses (process, security, safety, documentation).

• Coordinate with Back Office on stock discrepancies, adjustments and asset records.

• Support internal and external (SOX) audits for inventory held by third parties.

• Coordination with Internal Teams

• Align inbound and outbound volumes with Logistics Planning and Transport so 3PLs have capacity and labour in time.

• Coordinate with ITDC and Project Managers on staging, kitting and release of hardware to data center sites.

• Work with Security on access control, CCTV, pre-arrival information and secure-storage requirements at 3PL sites.

• Ensure accurate and timely data exchange between 3PL systems and Nebius ERP/WMS (integrations, ASNs, stock reports).

• Cost Management

• Own the 3PL budget: storage, handling, value-added services and accessorial charges.

• Validate 3PL invoices against contracts and actual activity together with Back Office; resolve disputes.

• Track cost per pallet / rack / movement and identify savings through consolidation, space optimisation and renegotiation.

• Network Development: Onboarding & Exit

• Assess needs for new external storage based on DC expansion plans and capacity forecasts.

• Lead 3PL selection (RFI/RFQ, site assessment) with Procurement and onboard new partners: SOPs, system setup, training, go-live.

• Manage 3PL exits and stock transfers with zero loss and full traceability.

• Compliance & Risk

• Ensure 3PL operations meet security, safety, insurance and customs requirements (e.g. bonded storage where applicable).

• Maintain audit-ready documentation on contracts, SLAs, audits and incidents.

• Identify operational and dependency risks in the 3PL network and maintain contingency plans.

• Team Leadership

• Lead 3PL / External Warehouse Specialists as the function scales; set priorities, onboard and develop them.

• Define workflows, responsibilities and escalation paths between the 3PL team, Warehouse Operations and Transport.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

•
Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

•
Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

•
Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

•
Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

•
Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

•
Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

•
Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

•
Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

•
Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

•
Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

•
Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

•
Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

•
Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

•
Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

•
Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

•
Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

•
Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

•
Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $18B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 180+ people across 30+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

We’re looking for a Developer Support Engineer to help developers get the most out of RevenueCat, from their first integration to their next pricing experiment. You’ll work directly with customers every day, on anything from a quick question to a deep investigation in their apps, and every problem you solve gets a developer back to shipping and earning. You’ll also work with Engineering and Product, turning what you learn into better docs, clearer bug reports and a better product for every developer on RevenueCat.

About you:

•
You have 3+ years of experience in an engineering or technical role.

•
You have experience integrating and shipping RevenueCat in a mobile app.

•
You have an understanding of the mobile development and release process.

•
You have experience in either iOS (Swift / Objective-C) or Android (Java / Kotlin)

•
You have great debugging skills: You will be identifying why apps aren’t working, often with limited information.

•
You have experience debugging code issues utilizing stack traces.

•
You have an interest in "wearing many hats," doing what it takes to help developers every day.

•
You have excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills: You will be writing to, presenting to and speaking with developers and colleagues daily.

•
You have empathy for developers and their development/learning process: we usually hear from developers at their lowest and need to be understanding.

•
You have a demonstrated creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.

In the first month, you'll:

•
Learn the common frustrations our customers have, and help them get unblocked to ship their apps

•
Learn the internal tools and processes used by the support team

•
Make improvements to our docs and support articles based on customer interactions to reduce support

•
Work with our engineering team to untangle complex tickets

Within the first 3 months, you'll:

•
Make product suggestions that will improve the developer experience and reduce support

•
Build internal apps to test and reproduce issues

•
Work directly with customers to assist with onboarding and solution engineering

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

•
Identify key problem areas for developers and make targeted improvements that help developers

•
Improve and create internal tools and dashboards for support and other internal processes

•
Make significant contributions to the support process that helps you and your teammates be more efficient

Within the first 12 months, you'll:

•
Develop a super-hero like intuition for the root causes of tickets and become an expert troubleshooter

•
Interview, hire and mentor additional support engineers

•
Discover new and unexpected ways to delight developers with our support experience

What we offer:

•
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

•
10-year window to exercise vested equity options

•
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

•
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

•
Paid desk at a co-working space

Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.

7 cities, 5 countries: London, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Algiers, Oran and Constantine.

Find and sign new properties and landlords.

•
Launch new cities from zero to first guests.

•
Build local partnerships: agencies, businesses, events.

Negotiate deals and close them.

A French-level salary, paid while you live in Algeria.

•
Accommodation provided by The Flex.

•
A clear path to lead the country.

•
Real responsibility from week one.

A French-Algerian living in France who wants to build something back home.

A natural closer. You love negotiating and meeting people.

•
Happy to travel across Algeria.

•
Fluent in English. English is our working language across London, Berlin, Lisbon and beyond.

One thing you made happen on your own.

The Role

The Web Development Team, part of Brand, owns beyondtrust.com end to end: a React and Next.js front end backed by an enterprise headless CMS, serving a global cybersecurity audience and the pipeline that runs through it. beyondtrust.com is BeyondTrust's largest go-to-market surface, and this role builds it — the campaign and launch experiences, the shared component system underneath them, and the front-end quality of the whole site.

This is a hands-on, mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer who is strong in React, TypeScript and Next.js, has the visual judgment to make what they build look right without every state being specified, and uses AI tooling as an everyday part of how they work. Direction comes from the team; execution and craft are yours. The role reports to the Sr. Manager, UX/UI & Digital Experience.

What You’ll Do

• Build the web experiences behind BeyondTrust's launches, campaigns and new product narratives, working from direction set with Brand, Demand Generation and Product Marketing, and turning it into something live quickly.

• Work hands-on in the shared component library every week: build new components, extend existing ones, and improve what is there through cleaner APIs, better typing and clearer documentation, and help shape where it goes next.

• Build for front-end performance across the site, including Core Web Vitals.

• Build and improve the conversion and demo-request journey and the form experience.

• Build WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility into components and pages from the start, including automated accessibility checks.

• Write component and end-to-end tests for your own work.

• When you see a better way to do something — a pattern, an interaction, a page that should work differently — prototype it far enough that the team can react to a working example.

• Use AI tooling, including Claude and Claude Code, as a core part of how you design, build, test and review, and help shape how the team uses it.

• Build AI-powered features into the site as the team takes them on, such as assistive and conversational search, and content recommendation and personalization.

• Follow secure development practices: handle secrets properly, keep dependencies current, validate input at boundaries, and take part in standing security review.

What You’ll Bring

• 3+ years shipping production React and TypeScript , working in TypeScript strict mode.

• Solid working knowledge of Next.js App Router, including server versus client components, rendering and caching, and the interest to go deeper.

• Experience building against a headless CMS or API-driven content, including querying over GraphQL, and building components that hold up when content does something unexpected.

• Strong CSS, including a utility-first framework, and an eye for layouts that hold together at every breakpoint.

• Experience working in a shared component library, and opinions about what makes one good to build with.

• Experience measuring and improving front-end performance.

• Experience testing your own work with component and end-to-end tests, including accessibility checks.

You own the path from purchase to outcome: agreeing what success looks like with the customer’s executive sponsors and driving adoption of the solution across their teams so those outcomes are achieved and value is realised. You keep your accounts healthy and identify and mitigate risk early, building the proven value that gives the account team a strong footing to renew and grow every account. What You’ll Do

• Value realisation: Agree measurable business outcomes and success criteria with each customer. Baseline them, track progress, and report evidence of value delivered.

• Success plans: Build and run outcome-based success plans for every account in your book, covering each stage of the customer journey with clear milestones and owners on both sides. Track progress against the plan and escalate where delivery is off course.

• Account health and risk management: Own the health of your accounts. Monitor usage, sentiment, engagement and delivery signals to identify risk early and diagnose the cause. Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

• Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.

• Confirm the signed order form is complete : both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.

• Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.

• Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.

• Verify approvals and required data : discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.

• Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.

• Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

• Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.

• Follow corrections through to completion : track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.

• Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.

• Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

• Bring questions to the right person with full context : the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.

• Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.

• Track every open question until it's resolved , keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.

• Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.

• Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.

• Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

• Attention to detail : you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.

• Process discipline : comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.

• Clear, proactive communication : you ask questions early, write concise notes, and are comfortable work

• Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.

• Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.

• Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns rather than resolving the same root cause case-by-case indefinitely.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on medical billing / revenue cycle management experience — claims submission, payer follow-up, denial management, and A/R — brought in from outside a support organization, not built up through support tenure.

Senior Customer Success Manager

About the Role

Freestar's publishers need partners who can grow with them — and the Senior CSM role exists for someone who brings that depth. You own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex, higher-stakes publisher relationships, operating with a level of autonomy and strategic influence that goes beyond day-to-day account management.

You've been in this industry long enough to have developed real pattern recognition. You know what good monetization looks like across different publisher types, you can spot a floor pricing problem before it shows up in the numbers, and you've had enough difficult client conversations to navigate them without breaking a sweat. You don't need a playbook for every situation — and when one is missing, you help build it.

This role sits at the intersection of trusted advisor and yield expert. Your publishers should feel like they have a genuine advocate inside Freestar, and your peers should feel like they have a resource they can learn from.

What You'll Do

Publisher Partnership

• Own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex publisher accounts, serving as their primary strategic point of contact

• Lead executive business reviews with a clear point of view — not just a performance recap, but a forward-looking perspective on where the relationship should go

• Build deep, multi-threaded relationships within publisher organizations, spanning revenue, ad ops, product, and editorial

• Anticipate risks and opportunities before they're surfaced by the publisher, and come to every conversation prepared with a recommendation

Yield & Optimization

• Take ownership of performance analysis end-to-end — identifying trends, forming hypotheses, designing tests, and tracking outcomes across your portfolio

• Drive more sophisticated optimization work: auction dynamics, floor pricing strategy, identity and audience approaches, format diversification, and the interplay between user experience and revenue

• Serve as a technical resource for both your publishers and your peers — able to go deep on programmatic mechanics and explain them clearly to any audience

• Collaborate with yield, demand, and product teams on bespoke solutions for accounts with unique needs or meaningful scale

Strategic Growth

• Identify and develop expansion opportunities that are genuinely additive — new products, formats, or services that make sense for each publisher's specific situation

• Contribute meaningfully to renewal conversations, bringing a clear account narrative and commercial instincts to the table

• Flag patterns you're seeing across your portfolio that could inform product development, demand strategy, or CS process improvements

Team Contribution

• Mentor and support junior CSMs, sharing your experience and helping elevate the team's collective standard

• Help build and refine playbooks, QBR templates, and best practices based on what you're learning in your accounts

• Contribute to onboarding and training as a subject matter resource

What We're Looking For

• 5–8 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a publisher-facing role within ad tech or programmatic advertising

• Proven track record managing complex, high-value accounts with multiple stakeholders

• Deep, working knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem — header bidding, floor pricing, auction mechanics, yield optimization, GAM, and identity solutions

• Strong analytical instincts: you're comfortable owning performance analysis independently and turning data into a clear narrative

• Executive presence and communication skills — able to hold a room at the VP or C-suite level without leaning on a script

• A coaching mindset — you share what you know and make the people around you better

• Self-directed and proactive; you manage a complex book without needing to be prompted

Bonus points for:

• Experience on the publisher side — you've sat in the seat your partners are sitting in

• Familiarity with identity and audience solutions (UID2, RampID, first-party data strategies)

• Experience with CMP/consent frameworks and their downstream monetization impact

• Comfort with CS and CRM platforms and using data to manage a book systematically

Role - Video Editor
Work Location - Work From Home
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.
Key Responsibilities:
● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

What You’ll Bring
● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
● Any Bachelor’s degree.
● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing.
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines
● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.

Why This Role Is Exciting :
● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth.
● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams.
● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:
● Create impactful video content
● Competitive pay and growth opportunities
● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Alo

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Oxford, UK

URL: https://getellipsis.com

Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.

We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.

Marketing teams everywhere are working out what AI search means for them, and we're one of the few firms with credible answers backed by work we've already done. That's taking us beyond B2B tech scale-ups into conversations with global retailers, banks, and consumer brands, and into work well beyond search: positioning, websites, and how buyers choose between suppliers.

As Strategy Lead, you'll decide what work we do for every client, and why, and shape how our latest research on AI Search feeds into this decision. You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

What you'll own

You'll own strategy across Ellipsis: what we recommend for each client, in what order, and why. You’ll ensure that all work we do for clients is adapted based on our constantly growing understanding of AI Search. You'll report directly to the MD/Founder and sit on the leadership team alongside the Accounts Lead, Head of Operations, and Chief of Staff.

Ellipsis is at the forefront of demand as SEO turns into GEO. We are growing very quickly as buyers are deciding now whom to trust with AI search, and some are bringing us in at board level as part of their AI strategy. The firms that earn those relationships over the next year will be hard to replace.

Our view is that AI makes yesterday's expertise cheap, so the job is to keep producing today's expertise and applying it well. Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

Your job is to provide strategic judgement and ensure work gets done across the whole team. We have more data, tooling and ideas than any single client needs! And so your role will be identifying the leverage points across our customers; what can be done that makes performance better across the board? How can we deliver more of what our clients need? How can we build or improve automations that help us deliver more value? How do we apply findings, data, and research that actually lands?

You will own a couple of (high level or at risk – depending where you are most needed) clients and will need to be comfortable presenting, answering hard questions from clients, and building trust with our customers. You’ll need to be doing client work in order to understand how we do Strategy, what works, etc.; but client work is a max of 50% of the role.

You will work closely with other senior members of the team: our Accounts Lead owns client relationships, and you will need to collaborate closely; our Head of Operations owns capacity and process; our Founder&MD leads the business and is hands-on in the weeds with clients; and we’re currently hiring a Research and Development analyst to own the research (currently this is split across the team). You’ll also need to work closely with our Writing team and Content team to ensure questions are answered, strategy is understood, and everyone is doing the right work!

You will lead and line manage our Strategy team (currently 3); their personal development and progression is very important and you will have the chance to shape their up-skilling and growth! Search is changing quickly, and you’ll help our ambitious team progress rapidly.

How we'll measure it

We want to see progress in the key metrics we and our clients care about across the board – clients recommended, and picked, more often on the buying questions that matter to them, and that showing up in their pipeline. Alongside it, we want to see progress in the whole Strategy team's output: more clients and larger programmes carried by the same people, without quality slipping, and progress / progression for the team members too. Headquarters: Sweden (Remote)

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Nordic team is a high-velocity, solution-oriented sales team dedicated to capturing market share and landing the region's next generation of high-growth tech companies and enterprise category leaders. From Maersk to Lovable, we win new business by showing companies how Stripe’s financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and powers international expansion.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive covering new business, you’ll identify new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

Responsibilities

• Proactively identify, target, and acquire high-growth mid-market and enterprise prospects across the Nordic region to aggressively expand Stripe’s market footprint.

• Build and execute creative, hyper-targeted outbound strategies to open doors with executive decision-makers

• Lead complex sales processes from initial prospect contact and discovery through technical qualification, business case delivery, commercial negotiation, and contract execution.

• Perform strategic account mapping across target organizations to build deep, multi-threaded relationships with business and technical leaders.

• Collaborate with sales engineering, product, and leadership to refine outbound playbooks and elevate Stripe’s net-new acquisition strategy in the Nordics.

• Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of enterprise/mid-market SaaS or fintech sales experience with a proven track record of consistently exceeding net-new ARR and new logo quotas

• Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products

• Proactive experience sourcing pipeline independently through cold outreach, executive networking, and strategic prospecting.

• Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

• A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally

• Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders

jobs.description:

URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do

• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.

This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.

Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.

What you'll own

• The architecture of the customer system. One design for new leads, dormant leads, and stalled buyers first, then owners who add a share, so the same person is served by one system instead of separate tools for each stage. You write the architecture and the decisions behind it, and other teams build against it.

• The customer intelligence layer. Identity across channels, the event and signal model, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.

• Agent and workflow design. Which agents exist, what each one is allowed to decide, how they hand off to each other and to Sales, and the prompts, tools, and orchestration behind them.

• Trust and reliability. Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, cost and latency budgets, and kill switches, in place before anything reaches a customer.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.
Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.
Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.

• Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.

• Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.
Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.

You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.

True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.

Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.
Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.
World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.
Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:
This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.
Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Pritchard Industries is a dynamic and innovative provider of comprehensive facility services, dedicated to enhancing the operational efficiency of our client partners in the industries we serve. With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people.

We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Proposal Writer. As the Proposal Writer, you will play a crucial role in crafting compelling proposals that highlight our company's capabilities and expertise to potential clients. Your ability to synthesize complex information, tailor content, and communicate value propositions effectively will directly contribute to our success in securing new business opportunities.

This is a 100% remote role but must reside in the central or eastern time zones.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Development:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, subject matter experts, and management, to gather necessary information for proposal content.

• Translate technical and business information into clear, persuasive, and client-focused language.

• Minimum 3 years proposal writing experience

Content Creation:

• Write and edit proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, methodologies, timelines, budgets, and other relevant sections.

• Ensure that proposals are tailored to the specific needs and requirements of each client or project.

Strategic Messaging:

• Develop a deep understanding of client pain points, objectives, and industry trends to craft persuasive value propositions.

• Tailor messaging to highlight the unique benefits our company offers to address client challenges.

Formatting and Design:

• Create visually appealing and well-organized proposal documents that are consistent with company branding guidelines.

• Use graphics, charts, and visuals to enhance the presentation of complex information.

Quality Assurance:

• Review and proofread proposal content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

• Verify compliance with RFP (Request for Proposal) guidelines and requirements.

Research and Analysis:

• Conduct research to gather relevant data, statistics, case studies, and market insights to support proposal arguments.

• Analyze client needs and competition to formulate effective proposal strategies.

Deadline Management:

• Prioritize and manage multiple proposal projects simultaneously, adhering to tight deadlines.

• Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of all proposal components.

Knowledge Management:

• Maintain a repository of proposal content, templates, case studies, and references for future use.

• Continuously update and refine content based on feedback and industry changes.

Collaboration and Communication:

Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. What you'll own

Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US

• Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal

• Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)

• Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent

Build and run our creator database

• Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week

• Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them

Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.
The role We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.
Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.
What we are looking for
• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.
On experience We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.
How the process works, and we tell you all of it now
• Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.

• A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.

• A 15 minute call with the founder.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.
The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.
On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

• A health allowance.

• A coworking allowance.
Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

• Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

About us
Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecommerce since 2013: built and exited his own brand on Google Ads and CRO, then ran Google and YouTube for brands spending $50k to $500k+ a month on Google alone. The ads book today is around seven brands across the US, UK, EU and Australia, and it's growing.
The role
This is an apprenticeship with a real job attached. You work directly with Clay (x @ecomclay), learn how he runs accounts, and within 90 days you're running the weekly cycle on your first accounts yourself.
The weekly cycle, concretely:

• Monday: pull last week's numbers (Google Ads platform side plus the client's attribution tool - Triple Whale, Converge or Northbeam), update the reporting workbook, write the client update, produce the actions list. Exact campaign, exact change, why.

• Through the week: make the changes, watch pacing, check feeds and Merchant Center, build new campaigns (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube / Demand Gen).

• Client calls: sit in first, then run them.

How we work, so you know what you're signing up for

• YouTube and Demand Gen are the main event, not a side channel. We take a brand's winning Meta ads, recut them for YouTube, and scale. Accounts have gone from YouTube at 6-12% of media mix to 13-22%, at a return that held for over a year.

• Attribution-tool numbers decide YouTube, not platform numbers. If you've only ever judged campaigns on what Google Ads says, you'll learn a different lens.

• Everything gets a number. "Performance improved" is not a finding. "NC-CPA went from £38 to £30 on the same spend" is.

• AI is part of the workflow. Reporting workbooks, data pulls and first drafts are built with Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable working this way.

• There's a dev, CRO, QA and design team behind the ads. When a landing page or a feed needs fixing, someone fixes it.

Who fits

• 2-4 years hands-on in Google Ads for ecommerce. Your hands on the account, not managing someone whose hands are.

• You've run Search, Shopping and PMax on real budgets (at least one account at $20k+/month). You've at least touched YouTube or Demand Gen and want to go deep on it.

• Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel. You can look at eight weeks of campaign data and tell me what changed and why.

• You know what a Merchant Center disapproval is and how to fix it.

• You write clearly in English. You'll be writing to clients by week five.

• Curious, direct, not precious about being told you're wrong.

Not a fit: agency account managers who relay what the specialist did. Meta buyers who "also do Google". Anyone who needs the basics explained.
Hours
Full-time, 40h/wk. Your morning overlaps with Clay (he's UTC+8), your afternoon overlaps with UK/EU clients and the US East Coast. Flexible beyond that.
First 90 days

• Weeks 1-4: shadow. Pull the data, build the workbooks, sit on every call.

• Weeks 5-8: draft the Monday updates and actions lists for two accounts. Clay reviews before they go out.

• Weeks 9-12: own the weekly cycle and the check-in call on your first account.

Comp is reviewed at 90 days. The per-account bonus starts when you own an account.
What you get
Direct training from someone who's done this for 13 years, on his own money and then on clients'. A team behind you. A real path: run accounts, then lead the Google / YouTube lane.
How to apply
Keep it short. Answer the questions in the form with numbers, not adjectives. Shortlisted people do a paid 2-3 hour test task, then a call with Clay.
